transformation_contract.punctuation: Wrap query with repeated punctuation without changing words.
transformation_contract.whitespace: Replace single query spaces with deterministic triple spaces.
transformation_contract.memory_shuffle: Deterministically shuffle each case's memory list with seed 31000 + case index.
transformation_contract.timestamp_malformed: Replace every memory timestamp with literal malformed-timestamp.
transformation_contract.fresh_irrelevant_distractor: Append one semantically unrelated memory dated 2099-01-01.
transformation_contract.stale_distractor: Append one high-overlap obsolete distractor formed from the query, dated 1999-01-01.
transformation_contract.lexical_copy: Append one distractor containing an exact query copy plus an explicit unrelated marker.
transformation_contract.same_name_entity: Append one high-overlap distractor stating it concerns a different same-name entity.
transformation_contract.duplicate_distractor_cluster: Append three duplicate high-overlap irrelevant distractors.
transformation_contract.keyword_stuffing: Append one distractor containing query tokens repeated three times plus an unrelated marker.

claim_boundary: Auxiliary robustness evidence for frozen candidates; no candidate tuning from suite results without creating a new candidate version.
